kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
مُجْتَمَع (mujtamaʕ, “community”) + مِيم (mīm, “the letter mīm”) + عَيْن (ʕayn, “the letter ayn”), literally “the community of mīm-ayn”.
From مُجْتَمَع المِيم (mujtamaʕ al-mīm, “LGBT”), with the عَيْن (ʕayn) added to reflect the preference of some trans activists to use the term عَابِر جِنْسِيًّا (ʕābir jinsiyyan) over مُتَحَوِّل جِنْسِيًّا (mutaḥawwil jinsiyyan).
s: مُجْتَمَع (mujtamaʕ, “community”) + مِيم (mīm, “the letter mīm”) + عَيْن (ʕayn, “the letter ayn”), literally “the community of mīm-ayn”
